LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: 32-bit float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: Monospace state card HUD.

SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss). No data lines or points are visible within the plot area (the axes are empty), though the legend is present. The purple animated marker and its trail are not visible in the plot area. The trend cannot be determined from the visual data.

TEXT: Step number: 54 / 59. w value: 1.4987703561782837. Loss: 0. FPS readout: 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s. Bit count: bits changed 9 of 32.

BITS: There are 32 bit squares drawn. The orange squares (representing changed bits) are located at positions 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 24 (0-indexed from left). The hex word is readable as 0x3FBFD7B5.

DEFECTS: The top-right "recorded series" panel is completely empty of plotted data despite being at step 54; no lines, points, or the purple marker are rendered. Some text in the state card ("dep") appears slightly misaligned or clipped at the top.

VERDICT: FAIL. The primary visualization panel (recorded series) fails to render any data series or the active marker, making it non-functional as a live view dashboard for this frame.
